goal: Independently review the local RV64 FDG-G1 byte-stable evidence serialization fix and determine whether exact temporary compile-root normalization preserves diagnostic sensitivity and the existing architecture claim boundary.

supplied_material: Scope is authorized local RV64 Verilog/SystemVerilog dual-issue OoO processor verification evidence only; no network, account, credential or external service.

Production RTL and design identity are unchanged: sha256:6236b176da0c10bccac9c2feb405a0d65ba586d826616f0beaeee0cbbfe2f3dc. The existing FDG claim remains four illegal FP encodings blocked, one legal FADD.S admitted, one precise full-core trap with exact PC/tval and CSR mepc/mtval, zero invalid-FP commits, 6/6 compile-success RTL variants rejected and 1/1 commit-observer sensitivity configuration rejected.

A final canonical replay exposed evidence-only drift: module and RTL-variant compile logs contained randomly suffixed per-run temporary build roots such as /tmp/rv64-fdg-v9d.XXXXXXXX and /tmp/fdg-variant-XXXXXXXX. These paths changed log SHA and FDG result SHA even when RTL, tests, diagnostics and outcomes were identical, causing the ledger closed binding to fail after a legitimate replay.

The implementation replaces only the exact pathlib.Path string returned for the current TemporaryDirectory with the literal token <FDG_TRANSIENT_TMP> before log hashing. It does not replace repository paths, source names, compile options, simulator diagnostics, oracle markers, return codes or result text.

Module-log normalization is fail-closed: log_dir must resolve inside the repository, the transient directory must resolve outside the repository with parent exactly /tmp and basename prefix rv64-fdg-v9d., the log inventory must be nonempty, every exact regular module log must contain the current transient directory at least once, and any mismatch raises an error before evidence construction.

RTL-variant and commit-observer logs use the same exact-string normalization while their compile-success detection, expected-marker checks, nonzero return-code requirement, [RESULT] FAIL requirement and source-before/source-after equality remain unchanged.

Three new regression tests cover pure exact replacement while preserving a repository source path, all live mutation/probe logs containing the declared token with no /tmp/fdg- suffix, and all 109 live module logs containing the token with no /tmp/rv64-fdg-v9d. suffix. The combined arch-stable audit and FDG/INSTRET tests pass 58/58.

Two consecutive canonical commands make -C npc/rv64 check-fdg-arch-trap both passed module aggregate 109/109, variants 6/6, observer 1/1 and source_unchanged=true. Across both runs the exact SHA values were identical: FDG result 6238dbef481273da7d6acc00156a9bf1a23c90ebfb610498053377b66df88fb0; raw log 47eb6b670d2ed21794fc0a2bd549cb8d823328f8e6044a343de8c1212302b765; mutation summary 0f3b95063c45cdec383e1e7f4754708fbe834db392fc4cf74e51988ee5490459; module summary c1512e98d3ba408e6331cba675632ca0f0ae8bcd0a061fe48791ff465cdac8e9; focused log a04421b43eea75f20a85c849786a14077e7b90663de1a94d1437bbae3583a27f; program log 17bab7e728bd4c617ab742160ec4543756765db87edc005663d868c1c9c266f3.

The architecture debt ledger was rebound to the stable FDG result SHA. The independent arch-stable validator then passed FDG closed binding and semantic evidence; full core remains ARCH_STABLE=GAP with 44 blockers, PPA UNQUALIFIED and promotion_eligible=false. Nine directed architecture gates remain GREEN.

Prior v2 review passed with no P0/P1 after commit-observer and PC/tval sensitivity hardening. Its retained P2 limits remain: no independent lane0/lane1 commit sensitivity cut, one trap transaction only, and no classifier mutation completeness claim.

deliverables: Return VERDICT=PASS or VERDICT=FAIL; list P0/P1/P2 findings with a concrete local RTL/evidence counterexample; explicitly decide whether exact transient-root normalization hides relevant diagnostics, whether the fail-closed path checks are sufficient for the stated claim, and whether the byte-stable replay evidence supports ledger rebinding; then restate residual limitations and claim boundary.
success_criteria: No unresolved P0/P1 evidence-integrity defect; preserve full-core ARCH_STABLE=GAP and PPA=UNQUALIFIED unless a concrete contradiction is identified.
